in_marathi.name: Rasmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ambrosia, Essence, Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rasmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rasmi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rasa' which means 'essence' or 'taste'. It is also associated with the idea of 'ras' or 'ambrosia', which is a drink that grants immortality. The name Rasmi is therefore a symbol of beauty, grace, and the essence of life itself.
